posts.title: Closing the post-discharge gap with Connect Kangaroo Mother Care
posts.description: Trained Frontline Workers carry Kangaroo Mother Care into the home, closing the dangerous gap that opens when families of small and vulnerable newborns leave the hospital.

posts.title: USAID Development Innovation Ventures and Dimagi partner on child health in northern Nigeria
posts.description: A new grant will scale and rigorously evaluate Connect, delivering Vitamin A and oral rehydration solution to children where coverage is lowest.

posts.title: GiveWell awards Dimagi funding to scale child health delivery in Nigeria
posts.description: GiveWell has awarded Dimagi more than $1 million to scale verified child health delivery across northern Nigeria, funding over 300,000 visits in 18 months.

posts.title: Connect reaches 100,000 service deliveries
posts.description: Across seven countries, Frontline Workers delivered more than 100,000 verified services, a foundation for scaling to millions of visits a year.

posts.title: Connect: a year in review
posts.description: The first year of designing and testing Connect: 77,000 clients reached, $161,000 paid to Frontline Workers, and the learn, deliver, verify, pay model proven in the field.
